guidetextdraw._value:
Information & Instructions

This form is used to change employees’ percentage of hours to be worked (FTE). Please contact HR if the request is to change other employment terms and conditions, such as responsibilities, salary…etc. Timebase changes can be initiated by management only. A Timebase of .50 FTE (20 hrs/wk) and more qualifies for health benefits. Contact Total Wellness at DL-TotalWellnes@fullerton.edu for more information.

  • If the requested change involves new or changed duties, an updated position description is required.
  • HR will notify the employee and all appropriate parties the outcome of the request.
  • Questions? Contact HR at extension 4355 or hrcc@fullerton.edu

Temporary Increase

Select this option if requesting a temporary increase for a part-time employee. If the employee is currently in a temporary position, the timebase increase duration cannot go beyond the employee’s current appointment end date.

Ongoing Increase

Select this option if requesting an ongoing increase for a part-time employee.

  • If increasing to full-time (40 hours/week) timebase, the position needs to be posted for recruitment per the Collective Bargaining Agreement because the conditions of employment are changing.

Temporary Decrease

Select this option if requesting a temporary decrease in hours to be worked. If the request is due to a leave, submit a request for a partial leave of absence instead or contact HR. To learn more about Leaves of Absence, contact Benefits at extension 3340.

Ongoing Decrease

Please contact HR for more information.

Extension Only

If extending, check box “Extension of previous duties” and indicate new end date.
